status_rule: ENTSOG Physical Flow at the corridor's entry series (the European operator's entry): in_service when any series has flow above zero on one of the last 30 closed gas days before the build; otherwise out_of_service, since the day after the last gas day with flow above zero ENTSOG publishes in the probed window (none found: the window's start is a bound, stated as 'no flow published since at least'); not_published when ENTSOG publishes no flow figure at all for the entry series in the last 30 days and no earlier flow was probed (the status is unknown, not zero).
use: presentation and fundamentals; route pricing never reads it
